_meta.description: Topology inference rules for the OCA visual system builder per BS-SPEC-OCA-002-REV0 §5.2

inference_rules.name: dead_end_detection
inference_rules.description: Component connected on one side only, or downstream valve closed, creates trapped volume susceptible to rapid pressurization.
inference_rules.trigger: Component has exactly one connected port, OR downstream component is a closed valve with no further connections.

inference_rules.name: flow_direction
inference_rules.description: Inferred from pressure differential and connection order. Source → highest pressure → lowest pressure → use point.
inference_rules.trigger: System pressure range defined. Components connected in series.
assumptions: Single flow direction unless bi_directional_flow_risk flagged
No backflow without check valve failure

inference_rules.name: velocity_estimate
inference_rules.description: Calculated from line inner diameter + system flow rate. v = Q/A where A = pi*r^2. Requires flow rate system input.
inference_rules.trigger: Line/tube component with inner_diameter_mm set AND system design_flow_rate provided.
assumptions: Incompressible flow assumption for velocity calc

inference_rules.name: sonic_flow_points
inference_rules.description: Orifice with sufficient pressure ratio to produce sonic jet downstream.
inference_rules.trigger: Orifice/restrictor component with upstream pressure > 1.89x downstream pressure (critical ratio for O2, gamma=1.4).
assumptions: No significant heat transfer at orifice

inference_rules.name: filter_protection_regions
inference_rules.description: All components downstream of a filter with no bypass path receive reduced particle impact risk.
inference_rules.trigger: Filter component present with bypass_path_exists = false. All downstream components in directed graph receive filter_integrity_assumed = true.
assumptions: Filter micron rating appropriate for particle sizes of concern

inference_rules.name: chatter_candidates
inference_rules.description: Regulators, check valves, relief valves with dynamic_contact_flag flagged as chatter candidates.
inference_rules.trigger: Component archetype is regulator, check_valve, or relief_valve AND chatter_susceptible config is true.
assumptions: Actual chatter depends on system dynamics not modeled here

inference_rules.name: upstream_volume
inference_rules.description: Volume of gas upstream of fast-opening valve. Affects adiabatic compression severity.
inference_rules.trigger: Valve with opening_profile = fast. Upstream connected components (vessels, lines) contribute volume.
assumptions: No additional flow restrictions between source and valve

inference_rules.name: bi_directional_flow_risk
inference_rules.description: GSE systems where venting may reverse flow direction, bypassing filter protection.
inference_rules.trigger: User sets bi_directional_flow_risk flag on system. Filter protection regions become invalid for reverse flow.
assumptions: User has identified reverse flow potential

zone_definitions.description: Upstream of any filter — particle entrainment possible
zone_definitions.rule: Components not downstream of any filter, or downstream of filter with bypass

zone_definitions.description: Downstream of filter with no bypass — reduced particle risk
zone_definitions.rule: Components downstream of filter where bypass_path_exists = false
Components with has_dead_volume = true from topology inference

zone_definitions.description: Valves, regulators, check valves with moving parts
Downstream of sonic orifices into closed-end geometries
zone_definitions.rule: Components downstream of sonic_flow_points with has_cavity_downstream = true
System pressure > 265 psia AND GOX/enriched-air AND component is non-exempt per MPR 53
